rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical size and for describing someone as young, as in 細個；it does not mean a small quantity.

example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 neoi5 zung6 hou2 sai3 go3

rows.note: Use this when “small” means few or not much in quantity, rather than physically little.

example.english: Only a small number of people came for dim sum today.
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lei4 jam2 caa4 ge3 jan4 hou2 siu2

rows.note: Use this when someone feels insignificant or inferior, especially in 覺得自己好渺小.

example.english: Facing such a huge world, I feel very small.
example.traditional: 面對咁大嘅世界，我覺得自己好渺小。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 gam3 daai6 ge3 sai3 gaai3 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 miu5 siu2

rows.note: Use this when “small” refers to a short duration or a limited amount of time.

example.english: The meeting is short, with a small amount of time allotted.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 wui6 ji5 ge3 si4 gaan3 hou2 dyun2
